LAREDO, Texas — Mario Rodriguez was arrested Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of indecency with a child by sexual contact, according to Webb County booking records.

Rodriguez was arrested at 8:09 a.m. by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. He is being held in the Webb County Jail on an immigration hold and was additionally booked as an out-of-county/state hold, according to the booking record.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record listed one charge; no court case number was listed.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Mario Rodriguez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
